verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for LocalAI. The only mention of 'usage tracking' is a multi-user admin feature enabled with LOCALAI_AUTH=true, which is an adjacent capability and not an opt-out control. A privacy opt-out is a fair question for a self-hosted AI runtime, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
